WITH pair_averages AS (
  SELECT
    f.orderslink AS orderslink,
    u.acctscope AS account_scope,
    AVG(f.feerate) AS average_fee_rate
  FROM fees AS f
  JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  JOIN users AS u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp
  GROUP BY f.orderslink, u.acctscope
),
mean_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(average_fee_rate) AS mean_fee_rate
  FROM pair_averages
),
ranked_pairs AS (
  SELECT
    p.orderslink,
    p.account_scope,
    p.average_fee_rate,
    p.average_fee_rate - m.mean_fee_rate AS excess,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY p.account_scope
      ORDER BY p.average_fee_rate - m.mean_fee_rate DESC, p.orderslink ASC
    ) AS rank
  FROM pair_averages AS p
  CROSS JOIN mean_average AS m
  WHERE p.average_fee_rate > m.mean_fee_rate
)
SELECT orderslink, account_scope, average_fee_rate, excess, rank
FROM ranked_pairs
WHERE rank <= 3
ORDER BY account_scope, rank;
